summary: Night lights off on vacancy (occupancy-driven) + stale room-config repoints + automation_mode registry cleanup
why: Night-lights-only entities had no URA off-path (all 3 off-paths were CONF_LIGHTS-scoped) so 5 rooms' night lights stayed on 20-29h until manually cleared. Operator corrected the premise mid-cycle: night lights must behave like any occupancy light (on when occupied+dark, off when vacant, always) — which SIMPLIFIED the fix to an unconditional union and voided the sleep-gate reviews. Verified: no canonical-reconciler flap, safe boot, 11 neuter-anchored tests, 0 new suite fails. Batched the two config-hygiene items (stale repoints + orphaned select cleanup) since they ride the same restart.
implications: Shipped NIGHT-LIGHT-NO-OFF-PATH-1, ROOM-ENTITY-STALE-CONFIG-1, ROOM-AUTOMATION-MODE-SELECT-UNAVAILABLE-1 at v5.92.1; card(s) sit shipped_organic pending validation. Acceptance in README_v5.92.1.md (Live criteria).
